dct_title_s: Windbreak Forests (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polyline coverage contains vegetation data, such as windbreak forests and small forested areas throughout China.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, environmental monitoring, management and impact analysis, economic analysis and other types of geographic analysis. These data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on land cover and associated areas of interest, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
